signingSteps: A platform administrator provisions one AGC Service Account credential outside the repository; project users do not open DevEco Studio.
Copy references/agc-provisioning-config.example.json outside the repository and point its credentialFileEnv to the protected credential path.

Rerun with --resume --agc-config <agc-provisioning.json>; the Agent reads the PC UDID, requests Huawei-authorized certificate/Profile material, signs, verifies, installs, and captures evidence automatically.
Existing authorized keystore/certificate/Profile material remains supported through --signing-config as a compatibility path.
Keep Service Account keys, API secrets, P12 passwords, and access tokens outside reports and source control.
acceptanceRule: Do not claim installation or feature parity until a signed HAP has been installed on device and reports/device-evidence-verification.json is passed.
